entities.note: 4x4 single-colour squares on a 6-px pitch occupying every slot of a rectangular loop of 20 slots: top row rows 19-22 (cols 12,18,24,30,36,42,48), right column cols 48-51 (rows 25,31,37), bottom row rows 43-46 (same 7 cols), left column cols 12-15 (rows 25,31,37); a button press moves every tile one slot along the loop
the one colour-11 tile, at rows 19-22, cols 42-45 (6th slot of the top row) on the first frame; rides the loop with the others

four 2x2 colour-11 corner marks at rows 17-18 and 23-24, cols 10-11 and 16-17, framing the top-left slot of the loop (rows 19-22, cols 12-15, which holds a colour-1 tile at the start); the goal tile must come to rest inside them
left-pointing colour-8 arrow at rows 29-36, cols 2-7, on the left edge of the board: rotates the loop one slot counter-clockwise (top row moves left)
right-pointing colour-14 arrow at rows 29-36, cols 56-61, on the right edge: rotates the loop one slot clockwise (top row moves right)
column 0: colour 14 = remaining presses, colour 5 fills from the TOP about 5 px per press (13 presses at L1); only button presses cost
eight 4x1 level pips on row 1 at cols 10-13, 15-18, ..., 45-48, all colour 5 on the first frame (a pip turns colour 14 for a level reached); not interactive
colour-4 board rows 13-50, cols 1-63 between colour-3 letterbox bands (rows 0-12 and 51-63); clicking either does nothing

rules.note: every tile on the loop moves one slot (6 px) counter-clockwise: top row leftwards, left column downwards, bottom row rightwards, right column upwards; costs 1 press
the colour-11 tile moves with the loop: from its start it needs 5 L presses to reach the socket slot
every tile moves one slot clockwise (top row rightwards); costs 1 press
15 R presses would also bring the goal tile round to the socket, more than the budget
a click anywhere except on the two arrows (tiles, socket marks, board, letterbox) does nothing and costs nothing; ACTION1-5/7 are not offered and also do nothing at no cost

goal.note: the colour-11 tile must sit in the slot framed by the four colour-11 corner marks (rows 19-22, cols 12-15); checked right after each press; minimal 5 clicks on the left arrow
